rationale: Keep the established product contract and demonstrate the SDLC workflow without external model access.
content:
# Requirements

Create returns 201; duplicate aliases return 409; invalid URLs return 400. Redirect returns 302, unknown codes 404 and expired/disabled links 410. Stats count background clicks; delete is soft. POST is rate limited and idempotent. Health and Swagger are available.

Codes are seven random Base62 characters. Timestamps are UTC; store an IP hash, never raw IP.

Replay scope: re-emit the already implemented Base62 generator and domain tests, write workflow documentation, then execute the full solution build/test gate. This recording is a deterministic demonstration, not a fresh implementation of every endpoint.

Approval accepts these requirements for this replay run.
